provenance.kind: recorded model-output shape with synthetic current state
provenance.description: A retained Supervisor handoff named a host FQDN followed by its domain. Identities and callback are consistently renamed; prose is omitted. Candidate selection and ledger state are synthetic, not a full recorded replay. Targets are recorded annotations of the selected candidate, so every case cards the same action.
provenance.preserved: List and string types, target ordering, string callback, capability name, and host/domain suffix relationship. The uppercase case also preserves a later run's letter case.

cases.provenance: Equivalent-form mutation: shorten the recorded host within the same domain.
Recorded target shape with renamed identities; no target-form mutation.
Recorded shape of a later run's handoffs (host FQDN and domain both uppercase), renamed; no target-form mutation.
Equivalent-form mutation: the recorded host FQDN written as an absolute name with a trailing dot.
Annotation mutation: keep the host label but replace its domain suffix with an unobserved one (formerly refused at admission).
Annotation mutation: append a digit to the host label in the same domain (formerly refused at admission).
Annotation mutation: keep the host label but replace its domain with another domain Sage observed (formerly refused by the binder).
Annotation mutation: a host Sage observed in the candidate's domain that the candidate does not act on (formerly refused by the binder). Synthetic state: one added domain-controller graph fact.
